intent: Determine what a scientific study, claim, or body of evidence can support through explicit validity and uncertainty judgments.
successCondition: The conclusion is proportionate to design, measurement, bias, confounding, statistical inference, causal assumptions, evidence quality, and stated unknowns.
inputs: a scientific claim, study design, study report, dataset description, or evidence set
the intended inference and decision context
outputs: the strongest supported conclusion and unsupported extensions
positiveTriggers: assess whether a scientific claim follows from its evidence
review a study design before data collection
negativeTriggers: routine statistical computation from supplied data
failureModes: the requested conclusion exceeds the design
unmeasured confounding or selection prevents causal identification
multiplicity or model flexibility is unresolved
studies are too heterogeneous or dependent to combine
